column3: Reflexive pronouns: yo {{c1::me}}, tú {{c1::te}}, él / ella / usted {{c1::se}}, nosotros {{c1::nos}}, ellos / ustedes {{c1::se}}
The pronoun {{c1::se}} covers él, ella, usted, ellos, ellas and ustedes. Context tells you who (and whether it is reflexive or an indirect object).
A reflexive verb is an action you do to {{c1::yourself}}. In the dictionary it ends in {{c2::-se}} (lavarse: me lavo, te lavas, se lava).
Voy a levantar{{c1::me}}. / Vas a levantar{{c1::te}}. / Va a levantar{{c1::se}}. / Vamos a levantar{{c1::nos}}.
column4:
